name: U24-1-handback
steps: if(!document.querySelector('.work-screen').textContent.includes('Waiting for input on DP-1 · Give input back'))throw Error('Missing hand-back row');if(document.querySelector('.nav__count').textContent!=='3')throw Error('Missing badge count')
if(document.querySelector('.work-screen').textContent.includes('Give input back'))throw Error('Hand-back attention did not clear')

name: U24-3-agent-after-queue
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');ui.selectProject(ids.pTide);ui.saveDraft(ids.pTide,null,{text:'Check the health endpoint',agent:{harness:'codex',model:'gpt-6-astra',effort:'medium'}});ui.reset('talk',[{screen:'talk'},{screen:'review',projectId:ids.pTide,taskId:null,intent:'new_task'}]);ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

(async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');if(ui.draft(ids.pTide,null)?.agent)throw Error('Task pin survived send');ui.selectProject(ids.pGarden);ui.saveDraft(ids.pGarden,null,{text:'Check the garden layout'});ui.reset('talk',[{screen:'talk'},{screen:'review',projectId:ids.pGarden,taskId:null,intent:'new_task'}]);ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

name: U24-5-review
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');ui.selectProject(ids.pNotes);ui.saveDraft(ids.pNotes,null,{text:'Check the layout in the Notes preview.'});ui.reset('talk',[{screen:'talk'},{screen:'review',projectId:ids.pNotes,taskId:null,intent:'new_task'}]);ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

const f=document.querySelector('.review-foot');const b=f.getBoundingClientRect();if(f.closest('.screen__body')||b.bottom>document.querySelector('.app__safety').getBoundingClientRect().top+1)throw Error('Review action not pinned');if(document.querySelector('.review__optional').open)throw Error('Optional starts expanded')

name: U24-6-annotate-source
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');const {seedAnnotation}=await import('/src/dev/sim/annotate.ts');const {annotationStore}=await import('/src/state/annotations.ts');const id=await seedAnnotation(window.__sim.host,'comments');annotationStore('sim-studio').update(id,d=>({...d,projectId:ids.pNotes,sources:d.sources.slice(0,1).map(s=>({...s,origin:{kind:'preview_capture',capture_id:'u24-preview',host_id:ids.host,computer_name:'studio',preview_id:'notes',preview_label:'Notes',captured_at:s.capturedAt}}))}));ui.selectProject(ids.pNotes);ui.reset('talk',[{screen:'talk'},{screen:'annotate',annotationId:id}]);ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

name: U24-7-library
steps: const f=[...document.querySelectorAll('.library-screen h2')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Folders on the computer');if(f.getBoundingClientRect().top>400)throw Error('Folders not first');if(document.querySelector('.lib-recovery-status').open)throw Error('Empty recovery expanded')

name: U24-8-blocked-work
steps: const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('.work-screen .row')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Approval needed · Run'));if(!r||r.textContent.includes('Ran retries_on_503'))throw Error('Blocker did not replace activity')

name: U24-9-queued-talk
steps: const e=document.querySelector('.composer__queue');if(!e||e.getBoundingClientRect().height>150)throw Error('Queue notice too tall');if(e.querySelector('details').open)throw Error('Details start expanded');if(e.querySelector('summary').textContent!=='Waiting')throw Error('Queue not loaded')
